{{Top|leg}}
"'''Amelkin versus Tovath'''" was a password used by the [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] guarding the hangar of [[Victory Base]], an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] base on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Halmad/Legends|Halmad]]. It was a reference to a classic match of [[Quadrant]], a game favored by the guards.<ref name="if">''[[X-Wing: Iron Fist]]''</ref>
